content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Graduate from any recognized University; Retired Judicial Employee from the category of Chief Administrative Officer/ Senior Superintendent and Superintendent; Retired as Member of TJMSS with satisfactory record of service, in the corresponding or higher categories. Experience required: Retired judicial ministerial service in the corresponding or higher categories. Age limit: Must not have completed 65 years of age. Pay: Rs.40,000 (Retired Judicial Employees only). Qualification required: Bachelor's Degree of any University in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act or an Institution recognized by the UGC, or any equivalent qualification; Telangana Government Technical examination in English Typewriting by higher grade or its equivalent examination (lower grade may be considered if higher grade candidates are not available); Knowledge or qualification in computer operation. Age limit: Must have completed 18 years and must not have completed 46 years. Pay: Rs.19,500.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract basis under Rule-9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996 Tentatively till 31.3.2027 or any date before that, or continued till further Orders of the Appointing Authority Deed of Agreement to be executed at the time of appointment Contract ceases automatically unless a fresh proposal is made and fresh contract is entered into Selected retired employees must produce Fitness Certificate and enter into Agreement/Contract with the Principal District and Sessions Judge

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Principal District and Sessions Court, Mahabubabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Principal District and Sessions Court, Mahabubabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk), 1 Typist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Principal District and Sessions Court, Mahabubabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application proforma on page 5 of the notification) and send it to The Principal District and Sessions Judge, Mahabubabad, by ordinary post / registered post / courier in a sealed cover; not accepted directly or in person, to reach by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk): must not have completed 65 years of age; Typist: must have completed 18 years and must not have completed 46 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.40,000 (Retired Judicial Employees only) for Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk), Rs.19,500 for Typist.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk): Graduate and retired Judicial Employee from the category of Chief Administrative Officer/Senior Superintendent and Superintendent. Typist: Bachelor's Degree, Telangana Government Technical examination in English Typewriting by higher grade (lower grade may be considered if higher grade candidates are not available), and knowledge or qualification in computer operation. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications invited from retired judicial employees and eligible candidates from Mahabubabad District. Senior Superintendent applicants must be of sound health and active habits with proven record of ability, good performance and integrity. Senior Superintendent applicants must not have received any punishment for misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employees who were dismissed, removed, compulsorily retired or made to seek retirement on Medical Invalidation.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Senior Superintendent: Oral interview (selection on experience, previous record and interview performance). Typist: Skill Test in Typewriting. Typist: Oral interview for qualified candidates; selection on merit in Skill Test and Interview. Senior Superintendent: oral interview; selection based on experience, previous record and interview performance; date to be informed later.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis under Rule-9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996. Tentatively till 31.3.2027 or any date before that, or continued till further Orders of the Appointing Authority. Deed of Agreement to be executed at the time of appointment.
